purpose: Geometric observation only: completed orientation interval to exploratory signed horizontal-motion descriptors. No neural feedback execution or biological visual transduction.

stage_a.method: Audit frozen repository semantics and derive coordinate transformations symbolically. No new biological claims or literature calibration are required.
stage_a.justification: World-to-view frame subtraction and interval change are coherent mathematical geometry. Interpreting the unwrapped Phase28 proxy periodically, rate normalization and side-basis projection are new bounded exploratory assumptions, not retinal/HS physiology.

layers.semantics: A fixed world-coordinate heading marker on an abstract periodic panorama; independent of body state.
Unwrapped Phase28 model coordinate; zero is aligned with world heading zero, positive is rightward. No physical yaw.
Wrapped world-minus-body coordinate, with unwrapped lift retained for interval differences.
Interval-mean change of relative view, not absolute positional error or biological velocity.
Globally bounded signed model-space descriptor projected into declared R/L bases; no neural execution.

coordinates.body_zero: Aligned with the zero world heading; conceptual +Z reference, no mutation of v1 fixed-heading geometry.
coordinates.period_rationale: Declare one orientation_eq per abstract geometric cycle solely in this observation model. Phase28 coordinates remain unwrapped proxies, not radians; this does not calibrate biological angle.
coordinates.maximum_interval_increment: abs(body_end-body_start) < P/2; equality or larger is rejected, not guessed or clipped.
coordinates.wrapped_body_inputs: Do not submit wrapped endpoints without winding; reconstruct a continuous unwrapped coordinate externally. Ambiguous half-cycle/multi-cycle jumps fail.
coordinates.reference_invariance: Adding the same constant to world and both body endpoints leaves relative geometry unchanged.

operator.relative_lift: r_before = world_heading_eq - body_before_eq; r_after = world_heading_eq - body_after_eq
operator.displacement: d = -(body_after_eq-body_before_eq); this is the winding-aware change of the relative lift, not naive v_after-v_before
operator.reference_rationale: One abstract cycle per shared frozen 50ms horizon is the unit reference rate. Chosen from declared model-space coordinates and horizon, not neural/orientation peaks or desired feedback stability.
operator.bounding: clip normalized_unclipped to [-1,+1]; report whether clipping actually changed the value
operator.sign: Fixed world and positive body change imply negative relative-view displacement, negative raw motion and negative global descriptor.

side_projection.semantics: Oppositely oriented side descriptor bases on the same abstract panorama: right positive is increasing view coordinate, left positive is decreasing. No separate hemifield coverage, weights or receptive fields.
side_projection.limitation: This is an explicit proxy-basis convention compatible with the frozen signed side-input range, not experimentally measured HS tuning or calibrated retinal projection. Both sides can be negative.

temporal.dt: Measured from finite consecutive endpoint times; strictly positive, not independently supplied or fixed to 0.1ms by the operator.
temporal.input_interval: At boundary n>=1, consume completed interval [n-1,n] with authoritative body endpoints and a held world reference.
temporal.output_boundary: n; available after the interval completes, held as input over the next neural interval [n,n+1].
temporal.initial_boundary: No completed interval at boundary zero: neutral R=L=0. Do not synthesize motion from an absolute offset.
temporal.update_order: Observe prior completed interval; latch descriptors; update sources/targets simultaneously from old states using Phase25 equations; update orientation from old bilateral target states using frozen Phase28 equation; next observation awaits the resulting endpoint.
temporal.final_boundary: Observation of the last completed interval exists, but is not consumed unless another interval is explicitly preregistered.
temporal.sample_rate_invariance: Equal constant model-space rotation rate yields the same normalized descriptor for different dt while interval-domain validity holds. Displacement alone intentionally scales with dt.

schemas.input: Typed immutable WorldReference, OrientationBoundary and ObservationInterval; no neural identities, counts, motor/body mechanics or opaque telemetry blob.
schemas.output: horizontal_motion_observation_v1: reference ID, interval indices/times, body endpoints, relative lifts/wrapped views, displacement, raw rate, unclipped/global/R/L descriptors, clipping flag, units/status, contract ID.

invariants: Zero change gives exactly zero global/R/L motion even at a static nonzero body offset.
Sign reversal of increments reverses descriptor unless both are zero; symmetric clipping preserves oddness.
Wrapped relative-view seam crossing uses the continuous lift and does not emit a spurious full-cycle impulse.
Neutral initial descriptor is independent of absolute heading.
Output lies in [-1,+1] for each side; invalid NaN/Inf or alias-domain jumps are errors, not saturation.
The operator has no neural simulation, orientation integration, structural contact weights or rendering dependency.
phase28_compatibility_check: Read validated stored orientation/time arrays only; check every interval API/schema domain. Never feed generated descriptors into Phase25 or recompute embodiment from them.
future_phase30_interface: A NEW preregistered experiment may connect completed orientation interval -> observation descriptor at next boundary -> frozen Phase25 equations -> frozen Phase28 orientation equation. It must declare initialization/exogenous perturbation, latched inputs, world independence, runtime invalid-state policy and acceptance of null results. Existing Phase25/28 canonical artifacts/conditions and Phase27 neural-only scenario are not changed or relabelled.

assumptions.name: World-minus-body frame transform and interval derivative
Fixed panorama and one orientation_eq per abstract cycle
Retinal, motion-detector, biological velocity and physical yaw calibration

allowed_claims: Analytical geometry, wrap and causal-order invariants
forbidden_claims: Calibrated optic flow or biological visual velocity
Neural or body execution from observation outputs
